tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background: the task list, the top bar, the status bar. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: One step up: the task detail pane, the settings nav, inputs, the terminal well, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Row hover, menus, popovers, dialogs, the selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Selected task row, pressed buttons, the active nav item. Never a page or panel fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: between panes, under the top bar, between section groups. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of menus, dialogs and secondary buttons where they sit on a surface of the same step.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Boundaries that identify a control: checkbox and radio outlines, the todo status ring, unfocused text inputs. Meets 3:1 on canvas and surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and task titles on canvas and every surface step. 13:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, brief body copy, menu items, settings help. 7.8:1 or better on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta and labels: section headers, timestamps, IDs, placeholder text, inactive tabs, icons. 4.9:1 or better on canvas through surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and done-task titles only, where WCAG exempts the text. Never for information the user needs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one chromatic accent. Fills the primary button (Run, Approve), the selected checkbox, the progress bar. Use at most once or twice per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. 5:1 on accent in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text or a mark on canvas or a surface: links, the live agent status line, the in-progress status icon, the @file and /skill tokens.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Faint accent wash behind @file and /skill chips and the live row of the run queue. Text on it uses accent-text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every focusable element. Solid, 4.4:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection and multi-selected task rows (with shift or cmd).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done status icon, a passed run, 'Connected' bridge dot. Always beside a word or an icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-review status, Urgent priority, a run waiting on approval, bridge 'unreachable'. Always beside a word or an icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed run, destructive actions (Delete project, Remove connection), form errors. Always beside a word or an icon.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a success badge or toast icon well. Text on it uses success.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a warning badge or the review banner. Text on it uses warning or ink.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a danger badge or failed-run banner. Text on it uses danger or ink.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the command palette.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title-lg
styles.sample: Fix bullet toggling in nested lists
styles.usage: Task title in the detail pane, settings page titles, empty-state headings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, brief headings (h2), settings group titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Toggle list type per item instead of for the whole list.
styles.usage: Long-form reading: the working brief, completion notes, task descriptions.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pressing Enter on a collapsed task creates an empty sibling
styles.usage: Default UI text: task rows, menus, inputs, settings rows.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, the selected nav item, emphasized inline text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section headers in the task list, tab labels, property labels, small buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, timestamps, help text under inputs, toast secondary text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Counters, badge text, keyboard hints. Never for sentences.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Terminal output, code blocks, file paths in briefs.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Task IDs, inline file references in meta lines, kbd keys.

spacing.note: 4px base. Rows and controls are dense; panes breathe.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside buttons and badges; gap between stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; row horizontal padding inside menus; icon-to-text in task rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Task row horizontal padding; input horizontal padding; gap between property rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane padding at narrow widths; dialog body padding; gap between brief paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and the first row in settings.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Detail pane and settings content padding at desktop width.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between settings groups; top padding of the detail title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd keys, checkboxes, @file chips, status icons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, task rows, menu items, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, code blocks, the terminal well, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette. Nothing larger exists.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only. Never buttons.

size.note: Fixed heights keep rows aligned across panes.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small and icon buttons in rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, tabs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in dialogs and the composer.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Task row height (body text plus 7px top and bottom).

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: size-statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar height at the bottom of the window.

tokens.name: size-detail
tokens.usage: Default width of the task detail pane; resizable 380px to 720px.

shadow.note: Depth comes from the surface ladder. Shadows are reserved for things that float above the layout.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the @ and / suggestion lists, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

duration.note: Motion confirms an action; it never decorates. All motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion except the live status pulse, which becomes static.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press color changes, checkbox ticks.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers opening, row expand and collapse, pane slide-in.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts entering. Exits use duration-fast.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything entering or changing state.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: dialogs closing, toasts dismissing.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky section headers in the task list.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, suggestion lists.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command palette and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
